prompt: Edit image 1, the final frame of the episode. Keep the room, the characters, their poses and the light exactly, but soften the whole scene into a gentle shallow depth-of-field blur and dim it slightly, so it becomes a warm backdrop. In front of it, centred in the upper half of the frame, a finished 3D animated film message card. The message, spelled exactly, with its final full stop: line 1: "Love is the thing you do.". Lettering style, locked for the series: a super-bold slab-serif display face with tight tracking, every letter a thick three-dimensional piece cut from sheet metal with a deep extrusion about a tenth of the letter height and a rounded bevel about an eighth of the stroke width. Procedural material that works for any text: brushed stainless steel with a faint grunge in the recesses, small rivet dots along the bevels, and a warm crayon orange edge light tracing the bevels. The whole title block is centred and fits inside the middle 85 percent of the frame width; longer titles get smaller, never cropped. At most four dominant colours: brushed steel, crayon orange, cool blue and the background's own tones. The lettering is solid brushed metal, facing the camera squarely at full size. Lighting rig, locked for the series: one warm crayon orange key light from the upper left, like a candle, and one cool blue rim light from behind on the right that outlines every letter; fine dust motes drifting in the light at low opacity; the background softly out of focus and a little darker than the lettering. No other text, captions, logos or watermarks. Every letter crisp and correctly spelled. Output one 16:9 full-colour production frame.
